name: Convex Sign
description: Sign UTF-8 text or hexadecimal bytes with an Ed25519 seed held in the caller's secret store. Returns only the public account key and signature.

seed.description: Secret reference containing a 32-byte Ed25519 seed, for example s/CONVEX_SIGNER

message.description: Text to sign as UTF-8, or hexadecimal bytes when encoding is hex

encoding.description: How to decode message before signing

accountKey.description: Public Ed25519 account key as a 32-byte Convex hex blob

signature.description: Ed25519 signature as a 64-byte Convex hex blob
